scope: Actual review of the v2 native overview against both source photos, limited to visible front and roof construction. Not a measured or photogrammetric whole-building reconstruction.
observations: Both low wing roofs now form continuous short-depth curved eaves connected to the setback wall; independent pointed pavilions removed.
Wing arched lattice upper panes and rectangular lower stained-glass panes are distinct; round windows have a restrained blue appearance.
The systematic whole-row brick colour bands are removed; mortar and recessed apertures remain visible.
Double tower eaves, roof tile courses, red columns, brackets, triple upper and middle front windows, blue plaque, high lettering and open doorway are present.
No obvious protruding high wing wall ends or detached roof surfaces in this reviewed view.
limitations: Absolute height, rear form, wall thicknesses and small details remain inferred.
This orthographic native overview does not validate third-person framing, collision or streamed replacement behaviour.
Carved lion figures and detailed historic painted ornament are simplified or omitted as declared.
Native render is not a claim of photographic material equivalence.
